method_influences.adapted_lesson: Make generation, evaluation, and selection phases explicit, with a bounded frontier instead of one opaque plan.
method_influences.not_adapted: No external code, LLM sampling loop, or self-reported vote authority is copied into the harness.

method_influences.adapted_lesson: Represent planning as inspectable operations over nodes and edges, while keeping controller authority separate from certification.
method_influences.not_adapted: No graph executor, optimizer, or aggregation code is vendored; graph-style expansion remains a bounded trace.

method_influences.adapted_lesson: Record selection, expansion, evaluation, deferred rollout/backpropagation, failed-branch lessons, and terminal risk boundaries.
method_influences.not_adapted: No stochastic UCT rollout, environment interaction, reward claim, or success certification is executed by this planner.

method_influences.source: saved run-local adaptive_research_inputs.json plus reproducibility/eval guidance
method_influences.adapted_lesson: Allow nondeterministic research to widen planning questions only after it is saved as provenance and validated deterministically.
method_influences.not_adapted: No external code, live network fetch, mutable research claim, or final-status authority is copied into this planning tree.

search_config.branching_policy: Expand task type, strategy candidates, selected execution, verifier handoff, and risk branch; defer higher-cost graph/MCTS expansion.
search_config.generation_policy: Generate run-local nodes only from existing goal, task type, strategy, expected artifact, adaptive research provenance, and verifier-handoff artifacts.
search_config.evaluation_policy: Evaluate deterministic proxy scores, applicability gates, saved adaptive research provenance, verifier-path presence, and risk notes; do not treat reward or research as certification.
search_config.selection_policy: Select the highest safe deterministic strategy frontier or route to NEED_USER_STRATEGY; keep rejected/deferred branches inspectable.
search_config.scoring_policy: Expose score_components on every node so strategy score, applicability, verifier path, risk, and bounded-budget effects are auditable.
search_config.reflection_policy: Failed/blocked/deferred branches are recorded as score reasons and pruned_or_deferred entries, not hidden or rewritten.
search_config.backpropagation_policy: MCTS-style rollout and backpropagation are deferred until rewards are verifier-backed and policy-gated.
search_config.stop_condition: Stop after selected verifier/risk branch or NEED_USER_STRATEGY; do not execute worker or certify final status.
